environment: private MySQL Compose project with real service binaries, mock upstream, Redis, and Prometheus
result: PASS all phases; private containers, network, and volumes removed
method: Each 12-chat burst was bracketed by fresh Prometheus scrapes. increase() and histogram_quantile(0.95) were evaluated at the ending scrape over that pair of scrapes. Counts are extrapolated Prometheus increases, not integer request totals. P95 is for status=OK only.
availability: All 12 chats in each outage burst returned 200; final request settlement succeeded. Existing revocation propagation and recovery assertions passed; RoutingOutboxDeliveryFailing and RoutingOutboxBacklog fired during outage and cleared after recovery.
boundaries: Legacy healthy and recovered bursts had no measured GetAuthSnapshot RPC, so their P95 cannot be compared with the single extrapolated outage sample.
V2 identity and billing P95 rose during the Redis outage and returned close to healthy levels in the distinct recovery window; the exact identity-side Redis fallback path was not attributed.
The conn-layer circuit-breaker rejects before the dependency latency interceptor, so this metric does not cover reject latency.
No production Redis fault was injected; production cost re-sampling still requires representative traffic.
